description: This file defines an interface WebSocketRouteBuilder for building Akka HTTP WebSocket routes with a fluent API, including methods to configure event sniffers, authorization, supervision, enrichment, header translation, and a build method to create the route.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building Akka HTTP WebSocket routes with customizable components such as event sniffers, authorization, supervision, enrichment, and header translation.

methods.name: withIncomingEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer for incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: withOutgoingEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer for outgoing WebSocket messages.

methods.name: withWebSocketSupervisor
methods.description: Sets the supervisor for the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Sets the signal enrichment provider; if not set, streaming requests with 'extraFields' parameter result in error.

methods.name: withHeaderTranslator
methods.description: Sets the header translator; if not set, streaming requests with 'extraFields' parameter result in error.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns the Akka HTTP route for WebSocket based on configured parameters.
